games.name: KILLJOY: INFECTION // ALPHA
games.desc:
KILLJOY is no longer in active development. Thank you all for your support.

❗ [ WARNING: This game contains blood and gore.] ❗

KILLJOY: INFECTION is a fast-paced zombie survival game where teamwork is key.

The year is 2022.
A deadly virus, known as the Olympus Virus, has escaped containment after a BDC bio-lab was breached. 

Originating from Martian fungus samples, it has spread rapidly across the East Coast of the Robloxian States, turning the infected into grotesque, mindless killers.

Society is on the brink of collapse—survival is the only option.

👥 Play with friends for the best experience.
🚧 ALPHA BUILD – This is a solo-developed game, and many assets are placeholders. Expect lots of bugs and changes.
⚡ Group & Premium Perks – Group members get an EXP boost, and Premium players receive a 1.675x EXP boost.

games.name: Orangutag! 🦧
games.desc:
We are working on a new game called "Monke Tag" which will be the sequel to Orangutag.

FAQ:
Q: Will Orangutag still be updated?
A: Only for bug updates, but no new content updates.

Q: When will Monke Tag be released?
A: We have no release date as of now. If we do we will update this page to let you know :) For now we're still developing the game.

Q: Will Monke Tag be different than Orangutag?
A: Yes, so far they are absolutely nothing alike and Monke Tag will have more unique features.

Q: What can I expect from Monke Tag?
A: You can expect things like an Item Shop, Accessories, Game Modes, and we plan on adding much more!
(When we say "Accessories" we're not talking about Avatar/Roblox Accessories)
